_about: Golden set for the holdout protocols.  [Addendum 2 section 11, step 6i]
Each entry names a peptide drug and the engineering motifs it carries. The
motifs are what the ablation protocols exclude on -- excluding by name leaves
the chemistry intact in other molecules, which is the flaw that made the
LITERATURE_ASSERTED and unverified in this build, like the other seed sets.
The modification lists are drawn from the addendum and from widely reported
drug descriptions; no primary source was read by this system.
